critical_path_summary.staffing_implication: Product Manager and Backend Developer must be dedicated (80% allocation minimum) across all phases; Frontend Developer and UX Designer front-loaded in Phases 1–2, then shared with QA in Phases 3–4.

phases.name: Discovery & Design
milestones: Stakeholder alignment session completed and scope signed off
User personas and success metrics defined
Architecture and data model approved
Workday API access and e-signature provider confirmed

tasks.name: Conduct stakeholder alignment session with HR leadership and IT team
tasks.definition_of_done: Scope document signed off by HR Director and IT Manager; success metrics and acceptance criteria documented.

tasks.name: Define user personas and success metrics for new hire and HR admin
tasks.definition_of_done: Personas document with adoption targets and satisfaction score baseline; success metrics mapped to business goals.

tasks.name: Design system architecture, data model, and integration points with Workday and Azure AD
tasks.definition_of_done: Architecture diagram approved by tech lead; database schema and API contract documented; SOC 2 audit logging design reviewed.

tasks.name: Create wireframes and user flows for onboarding portal UI
tasks.definition_of_done: Wireframes for all primary screens (checklist, document upload, team intro, progress dashboard) approved by PM and HR stakeholder.

tasks.name: Confirm Workday API sandbox access, documentation, and e-signature provider contract
tasks.definition_of_done: Workday API credentials and documentation received; e-signature provider (DocuSign or Adobe Sign) contract confirmed and integration guide obtained.

phases.name: Core Development (Sprint Cycles)
milestones: Sprint 1: Azure AD authentication and user session management complete
Sprint 2: Workday data retrieval and portal checklist UI functional
Sprint 3: Document upload and e-signature integration working end-to-end
Sprint 4: IT account provisioning automation for email and Slack complete
Internal demo with HR team; core user flows validated

tasks.name: Implement Azure AD SSO authentication and session management
tasks.definition_of_done: Users can log in via Azure AD; session tokens validated; logout clears session; UC7 implemented.

tasks.name: Build React frontend for onboarding checklist and task tracking
tasks.definition_of_done: Checklist displays all required tasks with due dates; task completion status updates in real-time; UC1 implemented.

tasks.name: Integrate Workday API to retrieve new employee data and pre-populate portal
tasks.definition_of_done: Portal retrieves employee name, department, manager, start date from Workday; data pre-fills form fields; UC6 implemented.

tasks.name: Build team introduction feature with member profiles and photos
tasks.definition_of_done: Team member profiles display name, role, photo, and bio; searchable by department; UC3 implemented.

tasks.name: Implement document upload and file storage with virus scanning
tasks.definition_of_done: Users can upload I-9, W-4, direct deposit forms; files scanned for malware; stored securely in Azure Blob Storage.

tasks.name: Integrate e-signature service (DocuSign or Adobe Sign) for document signing
tasks.definition_of_done: Documents can be e-signed via integrated service; signed documents stored with audit trail; UC2 implemented.

tasks.name: Design and implement audit logging for all document submissions and account provisioning
tasks.definition_of_done: All document submissions and account provisioning actions logged with timestamp, user, action type; logs queryable for SOC 2 audit; UC8 implemented.

tasks.name: Build IT account provisioning automation for email and Slack via Azure AD
tasks.definition_of_done: Email and Slack accounts created automatically when new hire completes onboarding; zero manual IT tickets; UC4 partially implemented.

tasks.name: Build HR admin dashboard for monitoring onboarding progress
tasks.definition_of_done: Dashboard displays all new hires, completion status, outstanding tasks, document submission status; filterable by start date; UC5 implemented.

tasks.name: Conduct internal demo with HR team and gather feedback
tasks.definition_of_done: Demo completed with HR Director and 2+ HR staff; feedback documented; scope changes (if any) prioritized for Phase 3.

phases.name: Integration & Edge Cases (Sprint Cycles)
milestones: Sprint 5: Additional SaaS tool provisioning (if applicable) and error handling complete
Sprint 6: Security review and SOC 2 compliance validation passed
All integrations tested end-to-end; edge cases and error scenarios handled

tasks.name: Extend IT account provisioning to additional SaaS tools (Jira, Confluence, etc.)
tasks.definition_of_done: All required SaaS tools provisioned automatically; UC4 fully implemented; zero manual provisioning tickets.

tasks.name: Implement error handling, retry logic, and rollback for failed account provisioning
tasks.definition_of_done: Failed provisioning attempts logged and retried; manual intervention alerts sent to IT admin; rollback cleans up partial accounts.

tasks.name: Conduct security review and SOC 2 compliance validation
tasks.definition_of_done: Security review completed; audit logging verified; access controls validated; SOC 2 compliance checklist signed off.

tasks.name: Test end-to-end workflows for new hire and HR admin with edge cases
tasks.definition_of_done: All primary workflows tested; edge cases (missing Workday data, failed e-signature, duplicate accounts) handled gracefully.

tasks.name: Implement data retention and deletion policies for 7-year compliance
tasks.definition_of_done: Automated data deletion scheduled for records older than 7 years; audit logs retained; compliance verified.

tasks.name: Perform load testing and optimize performance for concurrent users
tasks.definition_of_done: Portal handles 50+ concurrent users; response time < 2 seconds; database queries optimized; caching implemented.

phases.name: QA & Testing
milestones: All critical bugs resolved
UAT completed with HR team and new hire cohort
Accessibility audit (WCAG 2.1 AA) passed
Documentation and runbooks written

tasks.name: Execute comprehensive QA test plan covering all use cases and workflows
tasks.definition_of_done: All test cases executed; critical and high-priority bugs logged and fixed; test report signed off.

tasks.name: Conduct UAT with HR team and new hire cohort; gather feedback and sign-off
tasks.definition_of_done: UAT completed with 5+ new hires and 3+ HR staff; satisfaction score > 4.0/5.0; sign-off obtained; final scope changes documented.

tasks.name: Perform accessibility audit and remediate WCAG 2.1 AA violations
tasks.definition_of_done: Accessibility audit completed; all WCAG 2.1 AA violations remediated; screen reader tested; keyboard navigation verified.

tasks.name: Write user documentation, admin runbooks, and troubleshooting guides
tasks.definition_of_done: User guide for new hires; admin guide for HR team; IT troubleshooting runbook; all docs reviewed and approved.

tasks.name: Create adoption and communication plan for new hire onboarding
tasks.definition_of_done: Adoption plan includes email templates, HR communication schedule, and success metrics tracking; approved by HR Director.

phases.name: Deployment & Handoff
milestones: Production deployment completed
Smoke testing in production passed
Go-live sign-off obtained
Post-launch ownership assigned

tasks.name: Deploy portal to production environment on Azure App Service
tasks.definition_of_done: Portal deployed to production; database migrations applied; environment variables configured; deployment verified.

tasks.name: Execute smoke testing in production and validate all critical workflows
tasks.definition_of_done: Smoke tests passed; authentication, document upload, e-signature, and account provisioning verified in production.

tasks.name: Obtain go-live sign-off from HR Director and IT Manager
tasks.definition_of_done: Go-live sign-off email received from HR Director and IT Manager; production support plan confirmed.

tasks.name: Assign post-launch ownership and establish support escalation process
tasks.definition_of_done: Post-launch owner named; support escalation process documented; on-call rotation established; handoff meeting completed.
